meta.name: release-skills
meta.description: Universal release workflow. Auto-detects version files and changelogs. Supports Node.js, Python, Rust, Claude Plugin, GitHub Releases, annotated tags, historical release backfill, and generic projects. Use when user says "release", "发布", "new version", "bump version", "push", "推送", "release notes", "GitHub Release", or "回填 Release".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检测版本文件并生成发布流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发布新版本都要手动改文件、写更新日志
copy.tagline_en: Automatically detect version files and generate release workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually update version files and changelogs for every release

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在你说“发布”时自动执行发布流程：识别项目类型和版本文件，分析改动判断新版本号，按语言生成更新日志，更新版本文件，创建发布提交和带注释的标签，再按你的选择推送到远程库或发布到 GitHub Releases。
howto.when: 当你说出“release”“发布”“new version”等触发词，或运行 /release-skills 命令时触发。

say.note: 会询问版本号并展示变更摘要。

say.text: 用 dry-run 模式跑一遍发布流程。
帮我回填缺失的 GitHub Release。
say.note: 为已有标签补建历史发布。

howto.what_en: Claude detects project type and version file, scans commits since last tag, updates changelog per language, bumps version, creates a release commit and annotated tag, and optionally pushes to remote or publishes GitHub Release.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “release”, “发布”, “new version” etc., or run the /release-skills command.

say_en.note: Claude will ask version and show change summary.

say_en.text: Run the release flow with dry-run.

say_en.note: Create releases from past changelog sections.
